headline: Pac-Man - from Puck Man to arcade legend
title: The Story of Pac-Man | From Puck Man to Arcade Legend | Classic Games
video_script: In nineteen eighty, Namco released Pac-Man in Japan under the name Puck Man. It was designed by Toru Iwatani, and the player eats dots in a maze while four colored ghosts chase. For the overseas release the name was changed to Pac-Man, to stop vandals from changing the first letter on arcade cabinets. Which classic arcade game is your favorite? Comment below!
description: Pac-Man (1980) by Namco, designed by Toru Iwatani, was released in Japan as Puck Man and renamed Pac-Man for overseas arcades.
